rules.review_note: Preserve Info, exact close descriptor/error text, closesocket/close call, INVALID_SOCKET guard/reset and destructor behavior. SOCKET is unsigned on POSIX and UINT_PTR on Windows; preserve full bits despite legacy %d. Numeric last-error snapshot precedes builder, stringrendering remains guarded.
